name: sirbone-vscode
description: Chat panel that drives the sirbone CLI agent inside VS Code.

commands.title: Sir Bone: Sign in / set API key

sirbone.binaryPath.markdownDescription: The sirbone executable to run. The default searches VS Code's PATH and Cargo's standard user install directory, `~/.cargo/bin`. Explicit paths support `~`.

sirbone.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra command-line flags appended to every run. Use for options without a dedicated setting below, e.g. `["--anthropic-base-url", "https://..."]`.

sirbone.planMode.markdownDescription: Start Sir Bone in Plan mode. When enabled, the extension passes `SIRBONE_PLAN=1` to every new turn.

sirbone.contextWindow.markdownDescription: Model context window in tokens. Only drives the **ctx %** gauge in the status bar and is passed to sirbone as `SIRBONE_CONTEXT_WINDOW` so its compaction threshold matches. Set it to your model's real window (e.g. 200000 for Claude, 128000 for many others).

sirbone.model.markdownDescription: Model id to use for this workspace. Empty keeps the project's last model / provider default. Passed as `SIRBONE_MODEL`.

sirbone.thinkingBudget.markdownDescription: Extended-thinking budget in tokens: lets the model reason before answering. `0` disables it. Higher = deeper reasoning but slower and more expensive. Passed as `SIRBONE_THINKING_BUDGET`.

sirbone.maxSteps.markdownDescription: Hard cap on tool-call iterations per turn. `0` lets sirbone pick automatically. Raise it for long agentic tasks that hit the limit. Passed as `SIRBONE_MAX_STEPS`.

sirbone.grounding.markdownDescription: Mechanically verify the model's claims about the codebase (paths, symbols, counts) after a run. Recommended on. Turning it off sets `SIRBONE_NO_GROUNDING`.

sirbone.localize.markdownDescription: Run a localization pre-pass that finds the relevant files before the turn starts. Improves accuracy on large repos; costs a little latency. Off sets `SIRBONE_NO_LOCALIZE`.

sirbone.groundContext.markdownDescription: Front-load real file/symbol locations into the initial context so the model needs fewer exploratory tool calls. Off sets `SIRBONE_NO_GROUND_CONTEXT`.

sirbone.compaction.markdownDescription: Automatically summarize old messages when the context reaches ~87.5% full, so long chats keep working. Off sets `SIRBONE_NO_COMPACT` (long chats may hit the context limit).

sirbone.snapshots.markdownDescription: Take a shadow-git snapshot of the workspace before edits, so changes can be rolled back. Off sets `SIRBONE_NO_SNAPSHOT`.

sirbone.historia.markdownDescription: Enable read-only, schema-aware search across the project's persisted chat JSONL. Use `/historia [date or topic]` to retrieve prior work before continuing. Off sets `SIRBONE_NO_HISTORIA`.

sirbone.ace.markdownDescription: Enable ACE-lite: sirbone curates per-project 'lessons' it reuses across runs. Experimental / opt-in. On sets `SIRBONE_ACE`.

sirbone.hygiene.markdownDescription: Enable the post-edit hygiene pass. Experimental / opt-in. On sets `SIRBONE_HYGIENE`.

sirbone.yagni.markdownDescription: Add a 'You Aren't Gonna Need It' clause to the prompt to discourage speculative code. Opt-in. On sets `SIRBONE_YAGNI`.
